reason: The institutional-author PDF describes W4A8 quantization, hybrid systolic execution of convolution and attention, DSP packing, and pipelined nonlinear operators; it reports comparable FID/CLIP, an 8x parameter-size reduction, and 97.3x speedup versus Cortex-A53 for Stable Diffusion. This is a concrete edge accelerator result, but its target is diffusion generation rather than LLM inference.
title: SDA: Low-Bit Stable Diffusion Acceleration on Edge FPGAs
